subsystems.finding: TopoDS_Shape is a wrapper around a shared TShape plus location/orientation; OCCT object identity is useful internally but is not durable manufacturing identity.
subsystems.boundary: Keep TopoDS/TShape private to the geometry backend.

subsystems.area: B-rep entity tolerance storage and propagation
subsystems.finding: Faces, edges and vertices carry native tolerances; edges also carry same-parameter and same-range state.
subsystems.boundary: Map programme tolerance channels explicitly; do not equate them with one OCCT tolerance value.

subsystems.finding: OCCT provides native analytic and spline geometry integrated with B-rep and STEP workflows.
subsystems.boundary: Reuse internally without exposing concrete Geom classes in programme contracts.

subsystems.finding: Boolean APIs expose structured reports, fuzzy tolerance, parallel/non-destructive modes, images/origins, same-domain data and history.
subsystems.boundary: Translate options/status/history into programme-owned records.

subsystems.finding: Intersection/classification is central to General Fuse and therefore a plausible robustness seam, but no RCS-003 runtime evidence yet justifies modification.
subsystems.boundary: Do not fork until RCS-006/RCS-007 localize repeatable failures to this seam.

subsystems.finding: CellsBuilder exposes split parts, cell selection, material labels and internal-boundary removal, making it relevant to deferred/regularized research.
subsystems.boundary: Use only as an RCS-009 candidate until measured.

subsystems.finding: Unification exposes explicit linear/angular tolerances, safe-input mode, keep-shape controls and history.
subsystems.boundary: Invoke only under measured reconciliation policy; never silently heal committed dimensions.

subsystems.finding: OCCT contains broad healing facilities and STEP shape-processing hooks.
subsystems.boundary: Record pre/post metrics and policy; healing is not an unobservable fallback.

subsystems.finding: BRepCheck_Analyzer checks topology and geometric/parameterization consistency and supports exact/parallel modes.
subsystems.boundary: Use as a validation layer, not as the complete programme STEP conformance oracle.

subsystems.finding: Pipe-shell APIs expose frames, profiles, tolerances, approximation, transition policy, status and generated-shape history.
subsystems.boundary: Benchmark as cutter-envelope machinery; process-specialized solvers may bypass it.

subsystems.finding: BRepTools_History records generated, modified and removed relations and supports sequential history merging.
subsystems.boundary: Capture as backend evidence; do not serialize it as durable journal identity.

subsystems.area: Durable manufacturing provenance and semantic identity
subsystems.finding: OCCT history/naming tracks OCCT topology evolution, not the complete backend-independent manufacturing semantics required by the programme.
subsystems.boundary: RCS-008 owns the durable semantic ancestry model.

subsystems.finding: TNaming_NamedShape stores old/new shape pairs, evolution kind and version, but its suitability for programme provenance is unproven.
subsystems.boundary: Treat as prior art/internal option only.

subsystems.finding: Incremental meshing exposes explicit deflection parameters, parallel execution, custom context and status flags.
subsystems.boundary: Use for preview/diagnostics and sampled metrics, not as committed engineering geometry.

subsystems.area: STEP read/write, shape processing and sessions
subsystems.finding: STEP writer supports explicit solid model modes, tolerance, work sessions, shape processing and per-call parameter objects.
subsystems.boundary: RCS-005 defines success; isolate OCCT sessions and translate status into programme conformance layers.

subsystems.finding: Interface_Static is explicitly a global parameter registry; newer DESTEP_Parameters allows many STEP choices to be passed as values.
subsystems.boundary: Prefer explicit parameter objects; serialize or process-isolate unavoidable global mutation.

subsystems.finding: Algorithms expose per-instance parallel settings, but Boolean and meshing also retain static/global defaults.
subsystems.boundary: Do not claim whole-library thread safety; measure intended concurrent worker topology.

subsystems.area: Memory ownership, handles and shared shape state
subsystems.finding: Standard_Transient reference counts are atomic while TopoDS shapes share TShape state.
subsystems.boundary: Keep OCCT ownership/C++ ABI private; use programme-owned values and opaque IDs across the stable boundary.

subsystems.finding: OCCT 8.0.1 uses CMake 3.10+, defaults to C++17, supports vcpkg and defaults to shared libraries.
subsystems.boundary: Build a pinned toolkit subset behind OpenSimachinist rather than exposing OCCT to Godot modules.

subsystems.finding: Modified OCCT library code remains subject to LGPL obligations; the header exception permits header material in object code under chosen terms with prominent notice; upstream itself recommends shared production libraries.
subsystems.boundary: Keep derived OCCT code identifiable, preserve notices/source availability, and perform distribution-specific legal/compliance review.

fork_candidate_seams.trigger: RCS-006/RCS-007 reproducibly localize material correctness/robustness failures to intersection/classification or tolerance decisions that cannot be safely controlled above the subsystem.
Measured reconciliation requires deterministic behaviour that the public healing/unification APIs cannot express without silent dimensional/topological change.
Required ancestry is demonstrably computed internally but irretrievably lost before public history/adapters can capture it.

unresolved.question: Where does OCCT 8.0.1 fail or degrade across the RCS-003 corpus and parameter sweeps?
How should programme tolerance/equivalence/uncertainty channels map onto OCCT entity and fuzzy tolerances?
Can General Fuse/CellsBuilder provide useful regularized/deferred material-cell semantics at manufacturing scale?
How complete and stable is OCCT history for split/merge/replacement workloads compared with a programme-owned ancestry model?
Which STEP schema/body/product/healing/unit/tolerance policy constitutes programme success?
Does the intended worker topology safely isolate STEP sessions, global translation parameters and concurrent exact operations?
What is the minimal OCCT toolkit/dependency footprint for the Windows baseline harness and first backend?
What notices, source distribution, relinking/replacement and third-party-license measures are required by the actual production distribution?
